import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long n;
    static int minCost = 1000000000;

    static void search(long num, int cost) {
        if (cost >= minCost) return;
        if (num == 0) {
            minCost = cost;
            return;
        }
        long base = 1;
        int count = 1;
        while (base * 10 + 1 <= num) {
            base = base * 10 + 1;
            count++;
        }
        search(num % base, cost + count * (int)(num / base));
        search(base * 10 + 1 - num, cost + 1 + count);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextLong();
        scanner.close();
        search(n, 0);
        System.out.println(minCost);
    }
}
